protocol.cpu_threads: GeoPandas/GEOS native spatial join; no parallel partitioning
excluded: input GeoDataFrame construction and fresh copies
protocol.geopandas: geopandas.sjoin(left, right, how='inner', predicate='within') with native default indexing
protocol.headline_statistic: median of three paired alternating trials
included: MLX PolygonSet construction and GPU ingestion
GPU query and host result materialization
all left and right nongeometry attributes
protocol.input_copy: Independent GeometryArrays and attribute arrays; immutable Shapely geometry objects may be shared, but polygon prepared state is destroyed before every method
protocol.input_start: Already constructed matching GeoDataFrames, without cached indexes or prepared polygons
protocol.mlx: Fresh PolygonSet(right), GridIndex; query(left.geometry, all_matches=True, predicate='within', exact_boundary=True, backend='gpu'); attribute assembly
protocol.scope: Six synthetic point-in-polygon workloads; valid polygons, unique unnamed indexes, noncolliding attribute names
protocol.sorting: Both outputs sorted by point_id, then index_right inside each timer; original left index preserved
protocol.validation: Every warmup pair and trial pair: GeoDataFrame equality, exact attrs/index/columns/dtypes/CRS, zero-tolerance geometry coordinate equality
